prompt:
Research the officially documented limits for Discord users: message length and file upload size, for free users and Nitro subscribers. Cite Discord's own support pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on Discord's official support documentation, here are the documented limits for message length and file upload sizes for free users and Nitro subscribers.

### Message Length Limits

The standard character limit per message for free users is 2000 characters.
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034632292-Sending-Messages | QUOTE: "The character cap per message is 2000." | CLAIM: Free users have a 2000 character message limit.

Subscribers to the full Nitro plan have an increased message length limit of 4000 characters.
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034632292-Sending-Messages | QUOTE: "You can raise the character cap limit to 4000 when you subscribe to Discord Nitro." | CLAIM: Nitro subscribers have a 4000 character message limit.

### File Upload Size Limits

The standard file upload limit for free users is 20MB. This was increased from a previous limit of 10MB.
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/25444343291031-File-Attachments-FAQ | QUOTE: "For non-Nitro subscribers, the maximum file upload is 20MB." | CLAIM: Free users have a 20MB file upload limit.

Subscribers to the Nitro Basic plan have a file upload limit of 50MB.
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/33694251638295-Discord-Account-Caps-Server-Caps-and-More | QUOTE: "File Sharing Limit... Basic... 50MB" | CLAIM: Nitro Basic subscribers have a 50MB file upload limit.

Subscribers to the full Nitro plan have a significantly larger file upload limit of 500MB or 1GB, with official documentation stating both figures.
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/33694251638295-Discord-Account-Caps-Server-Caps-and-More | QUOTE: "File Sharing Limit... Nitro... 500MB" | CLAIM: The support article "Account Caps" states Nitro subscribers have a 500MB file upload limit.
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000435108-What-are-Nitro-Nitro-Basic | QUOTE: "Premium File Uploads... Share larger files up to 1GB" | CLAIM: The support article "What are Nitro & Nitro Basic?" states Nitro subscribers have a 1GB file upload limit.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A definitive, singular official file upload size limit for full Nitro subscribers that reconciles the 500MB and 1GB figures.
